activity.title: Activity
activity.hint: Downloads, imports and their speeds appear here as they start.

screen.notBuilt: This screen is not built yet.
screen.notFoundBody: There is nothing at this address. Pick a destination from the navigation.
screen.forbiddenBody: Your account is not allowed to open this. An administrator can change that.

connection.offlineBody: This device has no network connection. The screen updates itself when it comes back.
connection.reconnectingBody: The live connection to the server dropped. It is being re-established; nothing needs doing.

errors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: That username and password do not match.
errors.NOT_AUTHENTICATED: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: Your account is not allowed to do that.
errors.CSRF_FAILED: This request could not be verified. Reload the page and try again.
errors.LOGIN_RATE_LIMITED: Too many sign-in attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.OIDC_DISCOVERY_FAILED: That identity provider could not be reached or answered with something unusable.
errors.WEB_ASSETS_MISSING: The interface files are missing from this installation.
errors.CONFIGURATION_INVALID: This instance is misconfigured. Check the server log.
errors.DECRYPTION_FAILED: A stored credential could not be read. The application secret does not match the one it was saved with.
errors.BAD_REQUEST: That request was not something the server could use.
errors.NOT_FOUND: That does not exist, or no longer does.
errors.METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED: That action is not available on this address.
errors.CONFLICT: That clashes with something that already exists.
errors.PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE: That is too large to send.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Some of what was entered is not valid. Check the highlighted fields.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: The server ran into a problem. Check the server log.
errors.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: The server is not ready yet. Try again shortly.
errors.NETWORK_UNREACHABLE: The server could not be reached. Check that it is running.
errors.brokenTitle: This screen could not be displayed.
errors.brokenStep: Try it again. If it keeps happening, reload the page and report the address you were on.

errorSteps.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: Check the username and password, then sign in again.
errorSteps.NOT_AUTHENTICATED: Sign in again to carry on where you left off.
errorSteps.FORBIDDEN: Ask an administrator for access, or go back to the library.
errorSteps.CSRF_FAILED: Reload the page, then repeat the action.
errorSteps.LOGIN_RATE_LIMITED: Wait a minute, then try again.
errorSteps.OIDC_DISCOVERY_FAILED: Check the issuer address in settings, then try again.
errorSteps.WEB_ASSETS_MISSING: Rebuild or reinstall the application image.
errorSteps.NOT_IMPLEMENTED: Pick another destination from the navigation.
errorSteps.CONFIGURATION_INVALID: Correct the settings named in the server log, then restart the server.
errorSteps.DECRYPTION_FAILED: Restore the original application secret, or enter the credential again.
errorSteps.BAD_REQUEST: Change what was sent and try once more.
errorSteps.NOT_FOUND: Pick a destination from the navigation.
errorSteps.METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED: Go back and choose a different action.
errorSteps.CONFLICT: Open what already exists, or choose a different name.
errorSteps.VALIDATION_FAILED: Correct the highlighted fields, then submit again.
errorSteps.RATE_LIMITED: Wait a moment, then try again.
errorSteps.INTERNAL_ERROR: Try again. If it keeps happening, check the server log.
errorSteps.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: Wait for the server to finish starting, then try again.
errorSteps.NETWORK_UNREACHABLE: Check that the server is running and reachable, then try again.
errorSteps.unknown: Try again, and quote this code if it keeps happening.
errorSteps.generic: Try again. If it keeps happening, reload the page.
